$comment: Per-model evaluation settings for scripts/run-evaluations.py.
Models phrase correct answers differently, so each deployment is graded against
its own expected answers rather than one shared dataset.
Resolution order for a deployment, highest priority first:
1. an explicit --dataset on the command line (applies to every deployment)
2. the deployment's 'dataset' below
3. evaluations/<deployment>.jsonl, if that file exists
4. the 'default' block below
5. built-in defaults / other command-line flags
Because per-model files already resolve by convention, a deployment only needs an
entry here when it also needs a different threshold, system prompt, or a dataset
path that does not match its deployment name.
Settings: dataset, systemPrompt, passThreshold, similarityThreshold, similarityMetric
(fuzzy_match | bleu | rouge_l | meteor). similarityThreshold and similarityMetric are
properties of the evaluation definition, so deployments that differ on either get
their own evaluation created automatically.
model-router forwards each request to whichever underlying model it judges
best, so the answering model can change between runs without any change to
this repository. Its expected answers are therefore the least stable of any
deployment, and it is given a slightly lower bar so that routing churn does
not fail the pipeline on its own.
